rows.reason: Ask: score every control at freeze before any deciding run, and declare any --only previews at the content revision before the deciding run. Both halves exist at REV: the deciding script enforces receipt-at-REV + descending-from-freeze before starting any counter (lines 23-28), and criterion 99 codifies the order plus the report-listing obligation for any other invocation. Cited commit 14d03ea4 is the one that added the script (and the freeze itself). No counter-reading survives: the gate is real code, not just prose; the disclosure clause is conditional and had nothing to attach to.
